project_name: DepthWizard — Single-Image Depth-Assisted 3D Reconstruction and Height Estimation (SIH26175)

theme.style_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SIGINT GEOSPATIAL CYBER-GLASS
theme.concept: Tactical GIS Command Center with high-density data readout, synchronized 2D/Depth/3D inspection panels, and scientific rigor.

components: DepthWizard Brand Badge with Animated Radar / Depth Pulse Icon
Hero Preset Selector Quick Dropdown (Downtown High-Rise, Drone Campus, Oblique District, Nadir Satellite)
3-Min SIH Judge Presentation Mode Launcher Button
Pipeline Mode Badge (Depth Anything V2 Tensor / Geometry Fallback)

main_container.layout: Flex/Grid Dashboard with Mode Switcher Tabs (Inspector, Calibration, Measurement, Validation, Presentation)

hero_presets.title: Urban High-Rise Downtown
hero_presets.description: Dense high-rise commercial zone with LiDAR ground truth height benchmark data

hero_presets.title: University Campus Drone View
hero_presets.description: Historic stone structures and campus lawns with detailed elevation profile

hero_presets.title: Oblique Commercial District

tri_panel_inspector.panel_1: Raw Aerial 2D Image + Quality Analysis badge (Blur, Resolution, Angle, Cloud Occlusion)
tri_panel_inspector.panel_2: Depth Map Viewer + Colormap Selector (Turbo, Viridis, Magma, Grayscale) + .npy Export
tri_panel_inspector.panel_3: Interactive Three.js 3D Studio (Point Cloud / Mesh / Wireframe / Height Heatmap + Orbit Controls)
tri_panel_inspector.synchronization: Hovering on 2D image shows crosshair & synchronized normalized depth + 3D marker in real time

modes: Reference-Based: User selects building & enters known ground height (e.g., 18.5m)
Metadata-Assisted: Focal Length + Drone Altitude + Sensor GSD scale calculation
Terrain-Referenced: Automatic ground plane extraction (RANSAC fitting)
Relative Depth Mode: Uncalibrated 0-1 normalized depth display with warning label

features: Interactive bounding box/polygon selector over aerial image
Automatic baseline ground extraction vs building rooftop peak
Estimated metric height output (m) + Confidence Score (%) + Margin of Uncertainty (±m)

metrics: Error Distribution Scatter Plot (Ground Truth LiDAR vs DepthWizard Prediction)

presentation_mode.title: SIH Judge-Ready 3-Minute Walkthrough
steps: 1. Input Image Quality & View Geometry Analysis
2. Depth Anything V2 Inference & Raw Metric Surface

features: OrbitControls with pan, zoom, rotate, and orthographic/perspective camera toggle
Predefined Cinematic Flythrough camera animation sequence
Vertex color mapping based on colormapped depth or texture projection

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the layout is robust and ultra-responsive for dark theme SIGINT GIS dashboard aesthetics.
Implement synchronized crosshair inspection across 2D Image, Depth Colormap, and 3D Canvas views.
Add 'data-testid' attributes on all major buttons, dropdowns, inputs, sliders, and chart elements for automated testing.
Include preloaded hero datasets so judges can immediately interact with high-density ground truth benchmarks without requiring immediate manual file uploads.
Provide raw depth floating point matrix export (.npy simulation / json download) alongside normalized visual color maps.
Maintain high scientific honesty by showing confidence intervals, nadir warnings, and LiDAR benchmark comparisons.
